title: Atlas 4.0 Solid Grey

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Solid Grey is engineered for everyday agility, rapid ventilation, and effortless usability, pairing agile street ergonomics with certified multi-impact protection. Built around a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell weighing 1445g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~87 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Bold design with Shockwave Bluetooth audio system and magnetic chin vent.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Solid grey finish; fits most head shapes with adjustable retention system.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Solid Grey: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Solid Grey: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Solid Grey. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Ruroc's Full Face lineup, the Atlas 4.0 Solid Grey brings British engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Solid Grey represents Ruroc's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~87 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Solid Grey delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
